caseName: Brotherhood of Railroad Trainmen v. Virginia ex rel. Virginia State Bar
caseNameFull: Brotherhood of Railroad Trainmen v. Virginia ex rel. Virginia State Bar

opinions.text:
ante, p. 1. Motion of American Bar Association for leave to file a brief, as amicus curiae, in support of rehearing granted. Petition for rehearing denied.

Mr. Justice Stewart took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion and petition.
